title: Calibration-Induced Degeneracy in LLM Financial Forecasting: An Audit-Trailed Case Study on Next-Day Market Risk
abstract: arXiv:2608.20304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Costly LLM features matter only if calibration lets them affect the forecast. We document a failure of this link in a next-day risk study of two broad-market funds. Full-history scoring preceded the 2022 calibration. Calibration then set all four LLM weights to zero. The 856 later scores therefore could not affect the evaluation. We call this calibration-induced degeneracy. Allowing signed weights reactivated all four mappings. None improved forecasts after familywise correction. By contrast, a near-zero-cost headline count reduced SPY variance-forecast loss by 0.001720 (95 percent familywise interval: [0.000719, 0.002830]). The cheap baseline is therefore a critical diagnostic. We propose a calibration-viability checkpoint. Fit the mapping, perturb the feature over prespecified calibration values, and require a meaningful forecast response before acquiring holdout features. The check uses no holdout outcomes. Here, it would have stopped

translated_title: 校准引发的退化在大语言模型金融预测中的应用：关于次日市场风险的审计追踪案例研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：昂贵的LLM特性只有在校准能让它们影响预测时才有意义。我们在一项针对两只宽基市场基金的次日风险研究中记录了这种联系的失败。全历史评分发生在2022年校准之前。校准随后将所有四个LLM权重设为零。因此，后续856个评分无法影响评估。我们将此称为校准引发的退化。允许带符号的权重重新激活了所有四个映射。但在家族wise校正后，没有一个能改善预测。相比之下，一个近零成本的标题计数将SPY方差预测损失降低了0.001720（95%家族wise区间：[0.000719, 0.002830]）。因此，廉价基线是一个关键的诊断工具。我们提出一个校准可行性检查点：拟合映射，在预设校准值上扰动特征，并要求在获取保留特征前有有意义的预测响应。该检查不使用保留结果。在这里，它本可以阻止这种退化。
tldr: 本文揭示了LLM金融预测中校准可能导致所有LLM特征权重归零的退化问题，并提出一种无需保留结果的校准可行性检查点来预防此问题，同时强调廉价基线作为关键诊断工具的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that calibration can cause all LLM feature weights to degenerate to zero in financial forecasting, and proposes a calibration-viability checkpoint that requires no holdout outcomes to prevent this issue, highlighting the critical role of a cheap baseline as a diagnostic tool.
